title: Movement routes
description: Rules version 29: a ship with more than one legal way to the active system is offered a limited list of routes (at most 5), the default first. The default is the route the engine always took; the others differ in what they do on the way (rift dice, wormholes, anomalies, units to pick up), and a route that avoids a rift for Gravity Drive or the Ionian Fuel Refinery is listed beside the plain route through it. The movement tray shows the choice under a staged ship, the default preselected, each route with its consequences, and the map draws the chosen route. A ship with one way shows no selector. Synthetic fixtures with the shape of the host's movement facts (MoveFact.routes); reproduce with npm run screenshots -- HI.

shots.heading: One way: no selector
shots.caption: A cruiser with a single route to Mecatol Rex: the tray shows no route choice (desktop). The map's arrow joins origin and destination as before.

shots.heading: Two ways, default preselected
shots.caption: The default goes through the gravity rift and says it rolls for destruction (1-3); the way round needs Gravity Drive. The default is marked and selected, and the map draws it dashed red.

shots.heading: Safe route chosen
shots.caption: The route round the rift is selected: no die is rolled, Gravity Drive is spent, and the map draws the route through #25 and #26.

shots.heading: Five ways (the cap)
shots.caption: The most a ship is offered: the default, the safe route for the drive, and routes that differ in what they do (a wormhole hop, other systems passed).

shots.heading: Phone: two ways
shots.caption: 390x844: the routes stack under the staged ship, each at least 44 px high.

shots.heading: Phone: safe route chosen
shots.caption: 390x844: the way round the rift selected.

shots.heading: Phone: five ways
shots.caption: 390x844: the capped list, scrolled in the tray.

shots.heading: Map: safe route
shots.caption: Tray minimised: the chosen route is a solid line through #25 and #26 to Mecatol Rex.

shots.heading: Map: default route through the rift
shots.caption: The default route is drawn dashed red because it leaves a gravity rift (a die per rift).
